rule: Use these MDX tags only when the article has matching verified facts. Never invent keys, codes, dates, prices or steps to fill a block. Do not import anything. Do not use raw HTML.

blocks.when: Working redeem codes with a reward
blocks.example:
<CodeList lastChecked="2026-11-03">
  <CodeItem code="barnowl" reward="1,000 Plumes" status="working" checked="2026-10-31" />
</CodeList>

blocks.when: A single code mentioned in another article

blocks.example:
<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the Codes button">Top-left of the game screen, next to settings.</Step>
  <Step title="Paste the code">Enter it exactly, then submit.</Step>
</Steps>

blocks.when: In-game keys named by a source
blocks.example:
<Keybinds>
  <Keybind keys="Space" action="Take off" />
  <Keybind keys="E" action="Eat" />
  <Keybind keys="M" action="Open map" />
</Keybinds>

blocks.when: A limit, conflict, or missing fact the reader must not miss
blocks.example: <Callout type="warning" title="Unverified">Sources do not name a dive key. Do not guess one.</Callout>

blocks.when: Growth or life-cycle stages with named stages
blocks.example:
<Cycle>
  <CycleStage title="Egg">Laid in a nest or claimed hollow.</CycleStage>
  <CycleStage title="Hatchling">Must be fed by the family.</CycleStage>
</Cycle>

blocks.when: A player checklist they can tick off
blocks.example:
<Checklist>
  <CheckItem>Pick a bird at spawn</CheckItem>
  <CheckItem>Hunt once before nesting</CheckItem>
</Checklist>

blocks.when: Leftover real questions after the main answer
blocks.example:
<FAQList>
  <FAQItem question="Do codes give birds?">No. The listed codes pay Plumes only.</FAQItem>
</FAQList>

blocks.when: A collected YouTube video is the evidence for a mechanic
blocks.example: <YouTubeEmbed videoId="cv9VRpaQ8z8" title="Broodwing flight shown in a player video" />

never: Do not emit Steps with vague coaching and no named action.
Do not emit Keybind unless a source named the key.
Do not emit CodeItem for expired or invented codes.
Do not change prop names. Translate only human-readable text in later translate step.
